records.context: ``MemAvailable``, not ``MemFree``: free memory on a working machine is close to zero because the page cache holds the rest, and scheduling a trial against that number would refuse every trial on a healthy box. MemAvailable is the kernel's own estimate of what a new allocation could get without swapping.

records.source: ``MemAvailable``, not ``MemFree``: free memory on a working machine is close to zero because the page cache holds the rest, and scheduling a trial against that number would refuse every trial on a healthy box. records.translation: ``MemAvailable``, ekki ``MemFree``: laust minni á vél í notkun er nálægt núlli því síðuskyndiminnið geymir afganginn, og að raða tilraunum gegn þeirri tölu myndi hafna hverri tilraun á heilbrigðri vél. MemAvailable er eigið mat kjarnans á því hvað ný úthlutun gæti fengið án síðuskipta.
